brief.t: START HERE: Call Price Transfer CET now and confirm whether EMCU8614105 has cleared its customs exam and can be released today.

ACT NOW 1: Polo container EMCU8614105 arrived at Price Transfer October 10 and is still pending customs exam 5 calendar days later. Gaby said to check back today. Send: Gaby, please confirm whether EMCU8614105 has cleared the exam, whether it is available for release, and the earliest pickup time today.

ACT NOW 2: Tocopherol is physically at PLL, but Evelyn still has no verified lot-specific COA. The request is 2 calendar days old and may block QC release. Send: Alexandra, please send the lot-specific COA for the Tocopherol shipment now so QC can release the material today.

ACT NOW 3: Marcello requested 500 additional TALOVA lip balms after a stockout and asked for delivery confirmation on the prior 15,000 units. No later resolution is visible 6 calendar days later. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock and build timing for the additional 500 and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.

next: Recommendation: Clear the customs exam first, then release Tocopherol through QC and close TALOVA's stockout.

Displaced: Buffman, ActivePeptide, and Roon Body remain below Act Now because today's direct evidence gives Polo, Tocopherol, and TALOVA clearer live operational blocks; their movement or production status is still unverified.

Scheduled: 10 other operational items. The nearest dated milestone is Bulk Naturals order 99139, expected October 16; New Directions order 826890 is due October 20 and Mibelle PO 2026-00-0027 is due November 3.
Noise: At least 38 Outlook messages, none operationally urgent.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing returned no current records to rule out other supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane replied, but its Buffman and ActivePeptide status remains unsupported by current connected records. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Polo's container is pending customs exam at Price Transfer. Tocopherol remains on site without a verified COA. TALOVA's stockout and prior delivery remain unresolved.
redflags: EMCU8614105 has been at Price Transfer pending customs exam for 5 calendar days.
Tocopherol may remain blocked from QC release without its lot-specific COA.
TALOVA's additional 500-unit need and prior 15,000-unit delivery remain unverified 6 calendar days after the request.
